AtariST_8x16.ttf: the Atari ST high-res system font, from https://github.com/ntwk/atarist-font (BSD 3-clause, LICENSE-atarist.txt), converted from BDF with tools/bdf2ttf.py.
PxPlus_IBM_VGA_8x16.ttf and Px437_CompaqThin_8x8.ttf: The Ultimate Oldschool PC Font Pack by VileR, https://int10h.org/oldschool-pc-fonts/ (CC BY-SA 4.0, LICENSE-oldschool-pc-fonts.txt). The thin 8x8 is used for small captions.
Rotator_6x6.ttf: our own caption font, drawn from scratch in tools/font6x6.py (same license as the project).
